decisionsTitle: «Planul voluntarilor»: the note given with a new point, «Modifică punctul» keeping what was typed, «Pe puncte» drawn like «Tabel», and a changed note told again
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20**, of the four things §1009 left open on «Planul voluntarilor» — the note in «Adaugă un punct», keeping what was typed when «Modifică punctul» is refused, «Pe puncte» drawing a point's people as «Tabel» does, and a changed note reaching the people standing at its point: «Just do them all».

**Decision** (amending §1009, and §953 and §961 where named).

1. **«Adaugă un punct» takes the note too.** The two boxes «Notă pentru voluntari (română)» / «(engleză)» — the labels, help line, 500 characters and line breaks of «Modifică punctul» — stand after the coordinates. `addPlanPointAction` hands them to `changePlanPoint` kind `add`, which holds them to an edit's rules (`volunteerNoteOf`: both or neither, at most 500 each, `PLAN_POINT_NOTE_ONE_LANGUAGE` / `PLAN_POINT_NOTE_TOO_LONG` naming the box), read after the point's own boxes and before anything is locked, and stores them in the point's own insert. The add's trail says whether the point came with a note (`volunteer_plan.point_added`: `volunteerNote: { from: null, to }`), never its words. A refusal keeps every box as typed (§315), the note's two among them. At the start–finish and on the route alike.
2. **«Modifică punctul» keeps what was typed** (amending §953 for this one form). It is a kept form now, as «Adaugă un punct» is (`ActionForm`; `editPlanPointAction` in the `(previous, form)` shape): a refusal — a note in one language or too long, a name left empty, a kilometre that is no number, coordinates in no shape read, the point deleted meanwhile, a role that may not — comes back as the form's own state, never a redirect: every box as typed (the kind, the name, the kilometre, the coordinates, both notes), the sentence first in the form, naming its box as a link to it. One form a point, each with its own prefix for its boxes' ids (`plan-point-edit-<id>`), so two points' forms never share an id, and React hands a plain POST's answer to the one form that posted. The point's fold stays open: with scripts on nothing re-renders it and the form opens the folds around its sentence; with scripts off the refused POST draws the page afresh and a closed fold holding a refusal shows its body — the boxed fold's §336 rule, now one constant (`REFUSAL_UNFOLDED_SX`) that the pencil's own fold spreads too. A save that goes through is as before: back to the point, open, in the view it was pressed in, with its toast. The page's alert stays for the presses that land there («Pune aici», «Scoate», «Șterge punctul»).
3. **«Pe puncte» draws its people like «Tabel».** Each point's people: «1.», «2.», …, the name in bold and in capitals (the words as typed underneath, still the link to the person; amending §994's «Not in this change»), and a one-pixel line in the divider colour between two people of the same point — on the screen and on paper. «Fără punct» is no point's list: no numbers, no lines, its names as they were. Nothing else of the row moves.
4. **A changed note is told again at the next ordinary press** (amending §1009's «Refused» and §961's rule for this one field of a point). When a point's note changes — written, changed in either language, or taken off —, whoever stands at that point and was told it by a message that left before the change is no longer «already told»: the next «Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui» writes to them, and to whoever was not told anyway, each with their next telling — «Trimite din nou tuturor» is not needed, and nobody else is written to for it. The point keeps the moment (`event_checkpoints.volunteer_note_changed_at`, migration `0223`, expand only), stamped by `changePlanPoint` in the save's own transaction when — and only when — the note's words change after the service's trimming; a save that leaves them as they were, and a name, a kilometre, the kind or coordinates changed, stamp nothing and un-tell nobody. The rule is `point-mail.ts#tellingOf`, pure: a message still waiting (PENDING, PROCESSING) still tells — it is drawn when it leaves and says the note as it is then —; a message that reached the person tells only if it left (`sent_at`, else `created_at`) at or after the note's moment. Other points' people are untouched. The page's numbers follow («de anunțat», «își știu deja punctul») — the page reads them, and the count per point below, in one read, `readVolunteerPointMail`, in place of §956's `previewVolunteerPoints` (the page was its one reader, and it is gone) —, and «Pe puncte» says it where the people are: under the point's note — or under its bar, for a note taken off — one quiet line, never on paper, counted in both languages: «Nota s-a schimbat după ultimul email: 2 voluntari vor primi nota nouă la următorul „Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui”.» / “The note changed after the last email: 2 volunteers will get the new note with the next “Send each their point”.”, and for a note taken off that they get the point without it. The line shown when everybody knows their point no longer names the note among the reasons to write to everybody again. AGENTS.md §16.3 says the rule beside §956's, and §17 the page: the note in «Adaugă un punct», both kept forms (only a refused «Șterge punctul» still landing at the page's alert) and the one reader.
5. **The guide** («Planul voluntarilor: cine stă la ce punct», both languages): the bold names and the line are in both views, the note is written in «Adaugă un punct» or later with the pencil, a refusal keeps what was typed, and a changed note goes to that point's people with the next press.

**Why a moment on the point, compared with when the message left.** The memory of who was told stays the outbox's own rows (§956): no column on a person, no table. What a row cannot say is which note its message carried — it is drawn as it leaves (§331's rule) and the outbox keeps no moment of the drawing. The point knows when its note changed; the outbox knows when each message left. Refused: a version number on the point carried in the payload, and comparing with the queueing (`created_at`) — both are fixed at the press, so a message that waited (a paused road, a spent allowance) and left with the newer note would be called stale and written again to everybody it reached. **One edge, known and left as it is** (said in `point-mail.ts`'s head and in AGENTS.md §16.3, beside §956's): a message drawn a moment before the save and taken by the provider a moment after it says the old note and counts as told; `sent_at` is the one moment the outbox keeps, a column for the moment a message is drawn would close it, and a note saved in the second a message is in flight does not earn one.

**Refused.** Telling anybody again for a name, a kilometre, the kind or coordinates changed: §961 stands, «Trimite din nou tuturor» sends those. Withdrawing a waiting message when the note changes: it says the new note when it leaves. Telling anybody without the press: §956 — the organizer presses once, when the plan is right. The line under the note on «Tabel» or on paper: it is about emails, said where a point's people are worked on.

**Not in this change.** The email's own words; anything public; «Fără punct»'s names.
changelogLine: - **«Planul voluntarilor»: the note given with a new point, «Modifică punctul» keeping what was typed, «Pe puncte» like «Tabel», a changed note told again** — «Adaugă un punct» takes «Notă pentru voluntari» in Romanian and English; a refused «Modifică punctul» comes back with every box as typed and its sentence at the form, the point still open; on «Pe puncte» each point's volunteers are numbered, their names in bold capitals with a thin line between two, on paper too; and when a point's note changes after its volunteers were emailed, the point says how many will get the new one, and the next «Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui» writes to them — and only them. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given «Adaugă un punct» on `/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari`, then after the coordinates it has «Notă pentru voluntari (română)» and «Notă pentru voluntari (engleză)» — the labels, help lines and 500-character boxes of «Modifică punctul» — and a press with a note stores it with the point, in its own insert, in both languages with its line breaks, its moment the add's; one language alone or more than 500 characters in either is refused naming its box with nothing written, as the form's own state with every box as typed; a press with neither box, or both empty, adds the point with no note; and `volunteer_plan.point_added` says `volunteerNote: { from: null, to }`, never its words — on the route and at the start–finish alike (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 247 and §1009's criterion 316 for «Modifică punctul». Given a point's «Modifică punctul», when its save is refused — a note in one language or too long, a name left empty, a kilometre that is no number, coordinates in no shape read, the point deleted meanwhile, a role that may not —, then nothing redirects: the refusal is that form's own state, its sentence first in the form naming the box as a link to `#field-plan-point-edit-<id>-<box>`, every box as typed (the kind, the name, the kilometre, the coordinates and both notes), no other point's form refused, and the point's fold open — with scripts off too, a closed fold that holds a refusal showing its body; a save that goes through comes back to the point, open, in its view, with its toast, the form drawn afresh; the capability is asked at the action's door and again by `changePlanPoint` (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given «Pe puncte», then each point's people are numbered «1.», «2.», … in the point's order, each name in bold and in capitals and still the link to the person, with a one-pixel line in the divider colour above every person but the first, on the screen and on paper; «Fără punct» has no numbers, no lines and its names as they were (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 241 in the reader it names. Given a point whose «Notă pentru voluntari» changed after some of its people were told it by a message that left, then «Pe puncte» says under the note — under the point's bar for a note taken off — one line, never on paper, with how many of them the next «Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui» tells again, counted in both languages («Nota s-a schimbat după ultimul email: 2 voluntari vor primi nota nouă la următorul „Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui”.»), and the email's fold counts them among those to write to — the four numbers and these per point read in one read, `readVolunteerPointMail`, in place of `previewVolunteerPoints`; there is no such line once they are told again, on «Tabel», or at a point nobody is to be told again at (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criteria 69 and 71 for a point's note. Given `VOLUNTEER_POINT` rows, then a volunteer counts as already told the point they stand at only if their newest row still waiting names it, or the newest of their rows that reached them names it and left (`sent_at`, else `created_at`) at or after the point's `volunteer_note_changed_at`; `changePlanPoint` stamps that moment in the save's transaction only when the note's words change — written, changed in either language, taken off — and never for the same words after trimming, a name, a kilometre, the kind or coordinates; so an ordinary press writes to the people of that point told before the change, each with their next round and not as a resend, and to nobody else for it, while another point's people stay told (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 203 in the reader it names. Given «Trimite fiecăruia punctul lui», then `readVolunteerPointMail` — the plan page's one reader of the question's four numbers and of each point's count of people to be told a changed note again, in place of `previewVolunteerPoints` — asks `canManageVolunteers` before the event is so much as looked for, as `sendVolunteerPoints` does: the Tehnic role, the Redactor, a desk Volunteer and a member are refused (FORBIDDEN) whether the event is there or not, and an event that is not there is NOT_FOUND to the Organizer and the Administrators (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amends criterion 259 in where a refused note is said. Given `/admin/events/[id]/plan-voluntari` on a 320-pixel screen and on a desktop, when the Organizer adds a point with «Notă pentru voluntari», has a «Modifică punctul» refused, reads «Pe puncte» and changes a point's note after a send, then the add's note boxes are at least 44 pixels tall and inside the screen, the refusal is said at the form with everything typed — the note included — still in the boxes, the pencil open and the address unchanged, each point's people are numbered with their names in bold capitals and a one-pixel line between two on the screen and on paper, the line under the changed note says how many get the new one, the next press writes to that point's people alone, and nothing is wider than the screen. Verification: e2e `volunteer-plan-mail.spec.ts` under both Playwright viewport projects (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the note given with a new point, «Modifică punctul» kept on a refusal, «Pe puncte» like «Tabel», and a changed note told again
